- `Consumer`
- `NonPersistentDispatcherMultipleConsumers`

- `PersistentTopic`

- `SharedConsumerAssignor`
- `TransactionAggregator`
- `MLPendingAckStoreProvider`
- `PendingAckHandleImpl`

I found call sites with grep plus the Neo4j graph, and I only edited lines whose receiver I'd confirmed was a subscription. A call through an unusually named variable could still have been missed, so the follow-up build is the real check. The working copy has a CRLF warning on the touched files (git says LF will become CRLF the next time it touches them), but I didn't change any line endings.
